Targeted pass of a 664-page BREF. Locators are PRINTED page numbers (PDF page = printed + 30). Data are mostly EU (DE, FR, NL plant examples); some cost figures reprinted from US EPA (2003, 2008) fact sheets and older national sources (NOREC 2000, VITO 2010, InfoMil 1999, ETBPP 1996, Biothane 2000). Loaded: effluent treatment - complete-mix activated sludge, SBR, MBR and fixed-bed biofilter costs (Table 3.121); activated sludge WWTP energy per m3 and per kg COD abated and survey cost ranges (Tables 3.130, 3.133); MBR example plants Aramon (Table 3.137, costs p.315) and Roche Penzberg (p.315); UASB anaerobic pretreatment cost (Table 3.111, capacity derived from printed volume, load and COD); air and steam stripping (Tables 3.98, 3.101); evaporation steam ratio (Table 3.93); wet air oxidation costs (Table 3.63). Waste gas - straight, regenerative and recuperative thermal oxidisers (energy Table 3.202, costs Table 3.206 with column attribution checked against the US EPA footnote numbers), catalytic oxidisers (Tables 3.208, 3.211), elevated flares (Table 3.298) and four German central waste-gas incineration plants (Table 3.299: capex, stack flow; hourly consumables and stack CO2 in other-values). Names follow daginnus_2023 for oxidisers. Not loaded: pollutant concentrations, abatement efficiencies and BAT-AELs (non-GHG), particulate and inorganic-gas abatement, monitoring, diffuse VOC, odour, noise, sludge thickening, Chapter 5 emerging techniques (pollutant-specific, bench or single-site; no energy-relevant data), Figure 2.7 (chart only). Traps: 'Energy (kWh/...)' rows never name the carrier - read as electricity where fuel is listed separately, kept out where they include sludge incineration or steam generation; Table 3.206 is printed with the USD regenerative investment row offset from its column (footnote 1 = US EPA [54], the RTO fact sheet); Table 3.111 has an ambiguous second operating-cost line (other-values); most costs carry no price year (publication year 2016 used) - BREF conversions at fixed 1999 rates (FIM, DEM, NLG) or at stated year rates (GBP 1996, USD 2008) do not give a price year; US EPA thermal oxidation costs are stated as 2002 cost data and kept in 2002_USD.
